tools.name: search
tools.description: Ranked full-text search across the SvGrid documentation and demo catalogue. Returns the best pages first with an excerpt and an id you pass to `fetch`. Use this before writing SvGrid code so the API names come from the docs rather than from memory.

query.description: What you are looking for, e.g. "row virtualization".

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Return the full text behind a search result. Pass a doc slug ("help/columns/column-definitions") or a demo id prefixed with "demo:" ("demo:11-stock-market").

tools.name: list_examples
tools.description: Browse the SvGrid demo catalogue: id, title, category and a one-line blurb. Call with no arguments for the category index, then filter with `query` or `category`, then read one with get_example_source.

query.description: Free-text filter over id, title, blurb and category.

tools.name: get_example_source
tools.description: Return the full .svelte source of one demo by id (e.g. "11-stock-market") - working code to copy, not a summary of it.

tools.name: get_api_reference
tools.description: The SvGrid public API grouped by category (components, headless, scheduler, data ops, export, row models, features, virtualization, accessibility, utilities), for the version this server tracks.

tools.name: svgrid_check_code
tools.description: Verify SvGrid code BEFORE handing it to the user. Checks the source against the real exported surface of the current version - <SvGrid> prop names, ColumnDef keys, grid API methods, importable symbols and theme files - plus Svelte 5 runes rules, compiles it, and returns line-numbered diagnostics with the exact replacement for each, plus a corrected copy of the file (`fixed`) whenever the correction is exact. Run it on every file you write that uses SvGrid, use `fixed`, and run it again.

source.description: The full file contents to check.

filename.description: File name, used to pick which rules apply. Defaults to "Component.svelte".

tools.name: svgrid_preview
tools.description: Render a REAL, interactive SvGrid in the conversation - sortable, filterable, scrollable - from columns and rows you pass, or from a demo id. Use it to show the user what a grid will look like before they build it, and after svgrid_check_code to demonstrate the result. In clients without UI support it returns a text summary instead, so it is always safe to call.

columns.description: Column definitions, e.g. [{ "field": "name", "header": "Name", "width": 160 }]. Required unless `demo` is set.

data.description: Rows to display. Required unless `demo` is set. Keep it under a few hundred for a preview.

demo.description: Preview a shipped demo instead, by id (e.g. "11-stock-market"). Its source is returned as text; find ids with svgrid_search.
